description: Quine's Renovate defaults: what every repo's renovate.json extends (local>quine-global/quine-manifest//renovate/default). Renovate runs on the forge VM (petersweb-infra's nixos/renovate.nix).

packageRules.description: Our own images on the forge: their repos' deploy workflows bump them (quine-global/site-image), and the forge's copies of upstream images move by hand.
